criteria.text: Ten parallel local checks with PDD_MAX_JOBS=3 all finish with at most 3 runtime jobs active at once.
Checks, remote lint and Try setup share the same limit across repositories and worktrees; the default limit is 4.
A dead process does not free a slot while its runtime job still runs; confirmed completion or 30 minutes allows reclamation.
An interrupted or timed-out command retains reservations for unfinished or uncertain dispatched jobs, and releases jobs confirmed ended.

cases.given: 10 commands, limit 3, fake runtime tracks active jobs
cases.required_observation: all pass, measured maximum 3; no busy failure

cases.given: several repos/worktrees; check batches, lint, Try setup
cases.required_observation: shared cap 4; no parent reservation deadlock; browser session lifetime takes no slot

cases.given: dead PID; running, unknown, missing and wrong-ID receipts separately
same-ID terminal jobs, separately age 1800000 ms
cases.required_observation: reservation reusable; age 1799999 ms with running job remains occupied

cases.given: pending posted job, separately confirmed terminal and unsent job
cases.required_observation: retain pending; release ended/unsent; no extra dispatch
